option_relations.rationale: Acute Coronary Syndrome is a specific type of Coronary Artery Disease. The option describes a broader category that includes the leaf.
Acute myocardial infarction is a subtype of Acute Coronary Syndrome. The option provides a more specific diagnosis within the broader category of the leaf.
Acute coronary syndrome (NSTEMI) is a direct and specific form of Acute Coronary Syndrome, making it an equivalent clinical entity.
Non-ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (NSTEMI) is a specific type of Acute Coronary Syndrome. The option describes a more specific diagnosis within the broader category of the leaf.
